read.thesis: Hindalco India aluminium EBITDA up 55% YoY to INR7,009 crore at $2,125/t, but coal-driven costs rise ~5% QoQ and copper EBITDA of INR1,673 crore includes ~INR350-400 crore non-recurring gains; Novelis guidance held.

capex.peers_comment: Management said all competitors do pot relining; India capex ~INR12,000 crore this year, next year 'substantially higher'.
capex.quote: This year will be around INR12,000 crores. Next year will be substantially higher
